offers.description: Available as an individual service pick ($1,000 USD for individuals / $2,000 USD for businesses, each for 5 days of live training + 5 days of dedicated support, 10 days total coverage), or as part of our comprehensive programs: Business Training ($5,000 USD for 60 days: 30d training + 30d guidance/materials, up to 20 seats, +$250/extra seat) or Personal Training ($2,500 USD for 30 days: 15d training + 15d guidance/materials, 1 person only). Clients are free to pick and choose their services. Full 195-country Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) supported across all service pricing.

serviceOutput: Automated Spend Caps & Quotas: Enforcing organization-wide hard financial limits, per-seat budgets, and webhook alerts.
Token Caching & Context Pruning: Cutting waste up to 80% using prompt caching, semantic deduplication, and sliding windows.
Llama 3, Mistral & Qwen Routing: Offloading routine tasks to free tiers and open-weight models via LiteLLM proxies.
Runaway Loop & Leak Auditing: Catching infinite agent retries, redundant API calls, and zombie seat subscriptions.
FinOps Governance Dashboards: Tracking real-time token unit economics, ROI per team, and department usage policies.
